name: qkd_kvs_ctl_nc32f

pin_regs.reason: Generated wires-only parent of the static join: every tile <-> tile / die-master hop is priced in the compiled join ages with the die relays only (kv_relays, die_ages.json); a recipe-3 pin register would add an unpriced edge to every crossing.  The children land / launch their boundary nets in their own flops.

structural_change: KDIE5-RTL 10-22 (FB): die-bindable native-census kit of the release KV die qkd_kvs_ctl at the relm frame 1123.176 x 172.776: body = rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_die_20261017/qkd_kvs_ctl_nc32.sv (KV-CTL10 c32 members + DSTG, verbatim c32i body, census PASS max 32 in gate c32k; die knob OT_KV_CTL_NC32=1 with OT_KV_CTL_C32=2).  Pin plan / M6 pin-only grant = ctl_r1 (KDIE5-TV decision b).  6 ctl_sram_1r1w_64x128_p192 in two staggered rows near the centre; pin registers OFF (die charges 0 face edges, as ctl_r1).  Schedule deltas of the body: own leave guard +2, boot setup_ready +2, +1 boot-write edge (DSTG).
